confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA USD rate and one for Kaohsiung cost-of-living prices. The restaurant meal, beer and cappuccino anchors come from crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregators, and some of those are dated. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I set the cocktail at about 4x the local draft beer price and the wine glass at about 3.5x, based on typical Taiwan bar pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings. Hostel and hotel prices in Kaohsiung can vary a lot with events and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kaohsiung is a mid-sized Taiwanese port city. It is slightly cheaper than Taipei and Taichung and is comparable to other secondary East Asian cities.
